text_block_list.text:
The final day of the summer training camp 
has arrived—

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Come sit next to us on the bus!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on! Over here, over here~!

And so, on the bus ride shaking back 
toward the academy—

I take out my smartphone and open the 
message thread.

text_block_list.name: Jordan (LANE)
text_block_list.text:
"Bored. Everyone went to sleep. Got any 
interesting stories?"

text_block_list.name: Jordan (LANE)
text_block_list.text: “I'll listen now if you wanna talk.”

I exchanged a brief message with Tosen 
Jordan on my smartphone.
